introHtml: Polyester kitchen accessories offer durability and easy care for busy commercial kitchens and break rooms. From insulated lunch totes to stackable bento carriers, polyester resists stains and holds up to daily use. Decorate with your company logo via screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that lasts. Ideal for employee gifts or client appreciation.
